_help: Edit titles, subtitles and notes here. Each key under sets matches a data-chart-set attribute in index.html. Chart fields: id, type (line|bar), title, subtitle, note (omit to use defaults.note; empty string for none), alt, indicator, units, groups, year (bar only), and referenceLine. A referenceLine may specify value for a fixed target, or baselineYear, baselineGroup and reduction (fraction) to calculate a target from the baseline data. A chart with a views array gets toggle buttons; each view can override title, subtitle, note, alt, groups, units, type, year or referenceLine. The annotation field displays explanatory text below the chart; referenceLine.annotation labels the target line in the chart.
